title: 第9章 觉醒胶囊第10章 对自己长相很自信
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
没过多久，张雅就喊丘凌风吃饭了。
跟他想的一样，今天的菜比起过年还要丰盛不少。
丘凌风知道，这些食物，张雅在今天早上就在准备了。
为的就是庆祝他平安归来。
倘若他没有回来，那么今晚这一餐，怕是意义不一样了。
身为通脉境四段武者，丘凌风力气大了不少，但是食量也大了不少，总归是没浪费一点儿。
在形守村，晚上可没有什么娱乐方式。
所以喝酒吹牛就是打发时间最好的方式，加上今天张叔也有很多话要跟丘凌风说。
两人吃完饭之后就一边喝着酒，一边聊着天。
“爸，你和凌风都少喝点。”
张雅一边收拾桌子一边说道。
“知道了知道了。”
张大牛点了点头，不耐烦的摆了摆手。
“再过几天的话，金澜城就会来人选人进城修炼吧？”
张大牛问道。
“嗯，还有三天。”
丘凌风点点头道。
“你可要给你父母争气，去到金澜城里啊。”
张大牛喝着酒，道。
“张叔，进了金澜城我想要出来可就难了啊。”

丘凌风耸了耸肩道。
他有吞噬系统，在他看来，哪怕他不在金澜城的势力之中修炼也可以。
他还真的不太舍得张大牛和张雅。
前身的牵挂可都在这里。
金澜城的生活虽然代表着安定，但这何尝不是一道枷锁？
城里的人可不是想出城就出城的，没有一定的修为，连城门都无法踏出。
而想要踏出城门，就必须拥有道灵第一境的修为。
形守村连一个通脉境六段武者都没有，更别提道灵境的超级强者了。
道灵境，是通脉境之上的一个境界。
距离现在的丘凌风来说，还是太过于遥远了。
“这倒也是……”
张大牛皱起了眉毛，喃喃道，
“我是无所谓，只是小雅她……”
“张叔，先别说这个了，我还不知道能不能被选上呢。”
丘凌风嘿嘿一笑，说道，
content_en:
Not long after, Zhang Ya called Qiu Lingfeng to eat.
Just as he thought, today's dishes are much richer than those during the Chinese New Year.
Qiu Lingfeng knew that Zhang Ya had been preparing these foods this morning.
To celebrate his safe return.
If he hadn't come back, tonight's meal would probably have a different meaning.
As a fourth-level martial artist in the Tongmai Realm, Qiu Lingfeng was much stronger, but he also ate much more, so he didn't waste any of it.
In Xingmori Village, there is no entertainment at night.
So drinking and bragging is the best way to pass the time. In addition, Uncle Zhang also has a lot to say to Qiu Lingfeng today.
After the two of them finished eating, they drank wine and chatted.
"Dad, both you and Ling Feng should drink less."
Zhang Ya said while clearing the table.
"I know, I know."
Zhang Daniu nodded and waved his hand impatiently.
"In a few days, Jinlan City will come to select people to practice in the city, right?"
Zhang Daniu asked.
"Well, there are still three days."
Qiu Lingfeng nodded.
"You have to give your parents credit and go to Jinlan City."
Zhang Daniu drank wine and said.
"Uncle Zhang, it will be difficult for me to come out after entering Jinlan City."
Qiu Lingfeng shrugged.
He has a devouring system, and in his opinion, it is okay even if he is not cultivating within the forces of Jinlan City.
He really didn't want to let go of Zhang Daniu and Zhang Ya.
All the worries about my predecessor are here.
Although life in Jinlan City represents stability, is it not a shackles?
People in the city don't just leave the city when they want to. Without a certain level of cultivation, they can't even step out of the city gate.
And if you want to step out of the city gate, you must have the cultivation level of the first level of Taoist spirit.
Xingshou Village doesn't even have a sixth-level warrior in the Tongmai Realm, let alone a super strong person in the Dao Spirit Realm.
The Dao Spirit Realm is a realm above the Tongmai Realm.
It is still too far away for Qiu Lingfeng now.
"That's true..."
Zhang Daniu frowned and murmured,
"I don't care, it's just Xiaoya..."
"Uncle Zhang, let's not talk about this for now. I don't know if I can be selected yet."
